mapper.select: SELECT PROBLEM_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RECTIFICATION_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN RECTIFICATION_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) ELSE 0 END AS completionRate FROM TBL_RECTIFICATION_RECORD AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} GROUP BY PROBLEM_TYPE
